units.title_th: งานอดิเรก
units.goal_th: เล่าเรื่องงานอดิเรกและบอกสิ่งที่ทำได้
units.scenario: B is a senior student at a university club fair. Nam must talk about the hobbies she enjoys, say what she can and can't do, and choose a club to join.

lessons.grammar: like / love / enjoy + -ing (I love taking photos.)
don't like / hate / don't mind + -ing
can / can't for ability (I can play the guitar.)
Can you…? questions and short answers (Yes, I can. / No, I can't.)
be good at / be interested in + noun or -ing

lessons.topic: How often you do your hobbies
lessons.grammar: How often…? + once / twice / three times a week

lessons.topic: Club fair poster: the photo club, the music club and the board game club introduce themselves
Nam's diary: her first afternoon with the photo club at a lake in the park

units.title_th: ร่างกายและการไปหาหมอ
units.goal_th: บอกอาการป่วยและเข้าใจคำแนะนำของหมอได้
units.scenario: B is a doctor at the university clinic. Nam must describe her symptoms, say when they started, and understand the doctor's advice about rest and medicine.

lessons.grammar: have a + illness (I have a headache. / I have a cold.)
my + body part + hurts (My back hurts.)
What's the matter? + I feel + adjective
should / shouldn't for advice
imperatives for instructions (Take two pills. / Don't drive.)
well vs good (I don't feel well. / This medicine is good.)

lessons.topic: At the university clinic: Nam explains her symptoms to a nurse
Health center notice: how to avoid catching the flu

units.title_th: การเรียนและงานพิเศษ
units.goal_th: เล่าเรื่องการเรียนและงานพิเศษ และบอกสิ่งที่ต้องทำได้
units.scenario: B is Mr. Brown, Nam's English teacher. Nam must explain her weekly timetable and her part-time job, say what she has to do, and ask what she doesn't have to do for the course.

lessons.grammar: have to / has to for obligation (I have to study math.)
don't have to / doesn't have to (no obligation)
Do I have to…? / Does she have to…? (questions)
must / mustn't for rules
present simple vs present continuous (I usually… / Today I'm…)
from … to / until for time ranges (I work from six until ten.)

lessons.topic: An email from Mr. Brown about next week's exam
A student who studies in the day and works at a café in the evening

units.title_th: แผนการ
units.goal_th: บอกแผนการ ตัดสินใจ และให้สัญญาได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, a Canadian exchange student in Bangkok, before a long holiday weekend. Nam must find out Emma's plans, say what they are going to do together, and promise to help her.

lessons.grammar: be going to for plans (I'm going to visit my aunt.)
be going to: questions and negatives (Are you going to…? / I'm not going to…)
future time expressions (next month, in two weeks, the day after tomorrow)

lessons.topic: Deciding and offering on the spot
lessons.grammar: will for decisions made now and offers (I'll carry it for you.)
will / won't for promises (I'll call you. / I won't forget.)
time clauses: when / after / before + present simple for the future

lessons.topic: Emma's text messages about her flight home to Canada for the holidays
Nam's to-do list and diary for the week before her cousin comes to stay

units.title_th: เรื่องที่ผ่านมา
units.goal_th: เล่าเรื่องที่เกิดขึ้นแล้วและถามว่าคนอื่นทำอะไรมาได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, who has just come back from a trip to the south of Thailand. Nam must ask what Emma did and tell her about her own weekend using the past simple.

lessons.grammar: was / were (Where were you? / It was amazing.)
past simple regular verbs (-ed) and the three -ed sounds
past simple irregular verbs (went, saw, had, took, bought)
past simple negative: didn't + verb
past simple questions: Did you…? / What did you do?
past time expressions: ago, last…, in + year

lessons.topic: Nam's diary: a day trip to the old city of Ayutthaya
The day Emma lost her phone in a taxi, and how she got it back

units.title_th: การเปรียบเทียบ
units.goal_th: เปรียบเทียบสถานที่และสิ่งของ แล้วเลือกสิ่งที่ดีที่สุดได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, who can't decide where to go on her next trip in Thailand. Nam must compare Bangkok, Chiang Mai and Phuket and recommend the best place for her.

lessons.grammar: comparative adjectives with -er + than (Chiang Mai is quieter than Bangkok.)
more + adjective + than; better / worse
superlative adjectives with -est (the biggest, the highest)
the most / the least + adjective; the best / the worst
as … as / not as … as
the same as / different from / similar to

lessons.topic: Bangkok, Chiang Mai or Phuket? A short travel article compares three places
Emma asks Nam to help her choose between two hostels

units.title_th: ฤดูกาลและพยากรณ์อากาศ
units.goal_th: อธิบายฤดูกาลและพูดถึงพยากรณ์อากาศได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, who is going to Chiang Mai in December and asks about the weather. Nam must explain the Thai seasons, talk about the forecast, and say what Emma should pack.

lessons.grammar: will / won't for predictions (It will be very hot in April.)
might / may for possibility (It might rain this afternoon.)
be going to for predictions with evidence (Look at the sky! It's going to rain.)
zero conditional with if / when for general truths (When it rains, the streets flood.)
probably / definitely with will (It will probably rain.)
exclamations: What a…! / How…! (What a lovely day! / How hot it is!)

lessons.topic: A city weather warning: heavy rain and floods this weekend
Emma's email to her parents: the Thai hot season vs. a Canadian winter

units.title_th: เสื้อผ้าและรูปลักษณ์
units.goal_th: ซื้อเสื้อผ้า บอกขนาดและสี และบรรยายรูปร่างหน้าตาได้
units.scenario: B is a shop assistant in a clothes store at a Bangkok mall. Nam must find the right size and color, try something on, and describe the friend she is buying a present for.

lessons.grammar: present continuous to describe clothes (She's wearing a blue skirt.)
What does he look like? + have for features (He has curly hair.)
adjective order: size, color, material (a big black leather bag)
possessive pronouns (mine, yours, hers) and Whose…?
one / ones and Which one…? (I like the black ones.)
be made of + material (It's made of silver.)

lessons.topic: Nam tries on a jacket and asks the shop assistant for a smaller size
What to wear when you visit a Thai temple: a short guide for tourists

units.title_th: เช่าห้องพัก
units.goal_th: สอบถามเรื่องค่าเช่า เฟอร์นิเจอร์ และกฎของห้องเช่าได้
units.scenario: B is a landlord showing Nam a room near her university. Nam must ask about the rent, the furniture and the rules, and decide whether to take the room.

lessons.grammar: can / can't for permission (You can't smoke in the room.)

lessons.topic: Is it OK if I cook?
lessons.grammar: Is it OK if I + present simple…?
no + noun vs not any (There's no Wi-Fi. / There isn't any hot water.)
compound adjectives with numbers (a ten-minute walk, a two-room apartment)
How + adjective questions (How big is it? / How much is the deposit?)

lessons.topic: Things you need for a new room
lessons.grammar: need + noun / need to + verb (I need a lamp. / I need to sign the contract.)

lessons.topic: A notice on the dormitory board: a room is free, and the house rules
Nam's messages to Emma about her new room and her noisy neighbor

units.title_th: ธนาคารและไปรษณีย์
units.goal_th: เปิดบัญชีธนาคาร โอนเงิน และส่งพัสดุได้
units.scenario: B is a clerk at a bank in a shopping mall. Nam must open an account, ask about the ATM card, and find out how to send money to a friend in Canada.

lessons.grammar: I'd like to + verb (I'd like to open an account.)
Can I…? / Could I…? for polite requests (Could I check my balance?)
Can you…? / Could you…? asking someone to do something
How do I…? asking for instructions (How do I send this to Canada?)
verbs with two objects (Send me the form. / Can you lend me 100 baht?)
it takes + time (It takes five days to get there.)

lessons.topic: Bank notice: new opening hours and how to use online banking
Mr. Brown sends a birthday package to his mother in Canada, and it arrives too late

units.title_th: กีฬาและการออกกำลังกาย
units.goal_th: พูดเรื่องกีฬาที่เล่น บอกว่าเล่นได้ดีแค่ไหน และวางแผนออกกำลังกายได้
units.scenario: B is a fitness trainer at the university gym. Nam must talk about the sports she plays, say how well she can do them, and agree on a weekly exercise plan.

lessons.grammar: play / go / do + sports (play badminton, go jogging, do yoga)
adverbs of manner (quickly, slowly, carefully, well)

lessons.topic: When I was a child, I could…
lessons.grammar: could / couldn't for past ability
comparative adverbs (faster, harder, more slowly, better)
-ing form as subject (Swimming is good exercise.)
past simple irregular verbs for results: won, lost, beat (review)

lessons.topic: A young Thai badminton player who trains every morning before school
The university gym: rules and new class times

units.title_th: เทศกาลและวันหยุด
units.goal_th: อธิบายเทศกาลไทยและถามเรื่องเทศกาลของประเทศอื่นได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, who wants to know about Thai festivals. Nam must explain what people do at Songkran and Loy Krathong, ask how Canadians celebrate Christmas, and say which festival Emma should see.

lessons.grammar: present simple for customs and traditions (People throw water at each other.)
in / on / at with festivals and dates (at Christmas, on New Year's Day, in April)

lessons.topic: Why do people go to the temple?
lessons.grammar: infinitive of purpose: to + verb (People go to the temple to make merit.)
be called + name (It's called a krathong.)
every + singular noun vs all + plural noun (every year / all the children)
wish someone something (We wish you a merry Christmas.)

lessons.topic: Songkran in Chiang Mai: a short guide for visitors
Emma's email about Christmas with her family in Toronto

units.title_th: การชวนและการนัดหมาย
units.goal_th: ชวน ตอบรับหรือปฏิเสธคำชวน และนัดเวลาและสถานที่ได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, who invites Nam to a birthday party. Nam must accept or politely refuse invitations, suggest another day, and agree on a time and place to meet.

lessons.grammar: Would you like to + verb? + I'd love to / I'm afraid I can't (invitations)

lessons.topic: What are you doing on Saturday?
lessons.grammar: present continuous for future arrangements (I'm meeting Emma on Friday.)
Let's… / How about + -ing? / Why don't we…? (suggestions)
Shall we…? for suggestions (What time shall we meet?)
because / so for reasons and results (I have an exam, so I can't come.)
sound + adjective / sound like + noun (That sounds fun. / That sounds like a good plan.)

lessons.topic: Emma and Nam plan a surprise birthday party for a classmate in a chat
Mr. Brown's email inviting the class to an end-of-semester dinner

units.title_th: ทำอาหาร
units.goal_th: บอกส่วนผสม ปริมาณ และขั้นตอนการทำอาหารได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, who wants to learn to cook a Thai dish. Nam must say which ingredients they need, how much of each to buy, and explain the steps of the recipe.

lessons.grammar: countable and uncountable nouns (an onion / some butter)
some / any
How much…? / How many…?
a few / a little / a lot of
partitives: a piece of, a kilo of, a slice of, a jar of
sequencers: first, next, then, after that, finally

lessons.topic: Cooking pad kra pao together: Nam shows Emma what to do
A recipe card: green curry for four people

units.title_th: โทรศัพท์และอินเทอร์เน็ต
units.goal_th: อธิบายปัญหาโทรศัพท์และใช้คำศัพท์เกี่ยวกับแอปและอินเทอร์เน็ตได้
units.scenario: B is an assistant in a mobile phone shop. Nam's phone is not working well; she must explain the problem, ask about a new charger, and ask how to set up her apps.

lessons.grammar: something / anything / nothing / everything
someone / anyone / no one / everyone
when + past simple (When I opened the app, it closed.)

lessons.topic: Click here, then type your password (review)
lessons.grammar: imperatives for app instructions: click, tap, type (review)

lessons.topic: Turn it on and log in
lessons.grammar: phrasal verbs with on / off / in / up (turn on, log in, sign up)
verbs with prepositions: reply to, chat with, look at, worry about

lessons.topic: A family chat: Nam teaches her grandmother how to make a video call
Internet safety tips from the university IT center

units.title_th: อาชีพ
units.goal_th: บอกว่าใครทำอาชีพอะไร ทำงานที่ไหน และอยากทำอาชีพอะไรในอนาคตได้
units.scenario: B is Mr. Brown, who asks his students about jobs. Nam must describe what different people do and where they work, and say what job she would like in the future and why.

lessons.grammar: work as / work for / work in (She works as a lawyer for a big company.)

lessons.topic: What do you want to be?
lessons.grammar: a / an with jobs; want to be / would like to be (I'd like to be an architect.)
for + time period with the past simple (I worked there for two years.)
comparatives and superlatives to compare jobs (review)
word formation: -er / -or / -ist / -ian for jobs (art → artist)

lessons.topic: I'd love to be a vet
lessons.grammar: would for imagined preferences (I'd love to be… / I wouldn't like to be…)

lessons.topic: Three people, three jobs: a chef, a nurse and a tour guide describe their day
Why Mr. Brown left his office job in Canada to teach English in Thailand

units.title_th: ประสบการณ์การเดินทาง
units.goal_th: เล่าประสบการณ์การเดินทางและถามว่าคนอื่นเคยไปที่ไหนมาบ้างได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, who is making a list of places to visit before she goes home to Canada. Nam must ask where Emma has been, talk about her own travel experiences, and recommend a place Emma has never visited.

lessons.grammar: present perfect: Have you ever…? (experience questions)
present perfect statements with never (I've never seen snow.)
past participles of irregular verbs (been, seen, eaten, flown)
been vs gone (She's been to Japan. / She's gone to Japan.)
present perfect vs past simple (I've been to Krabi. I went there last year.)

lessons.topic: How many countries have you visited?
lessons.grammar: How many times have you…? / once, twice, several times

lessons.topic: A Canadian travel blogger who has visited fifty countries
Nam's travel diary: her first trip abroad, to Japan in spring

units.title_th: ปัญหาระหว่างเดินทาง
units.goal_th: อธิบายปัญหาที่เกิดขึ้นระหว่างเดินทางและขอความช่วยเหลือได้
units.scenario: B is an airline employee at the baggage desk at Suvarnabhumi Airport. Nam's bag did not arrive; she must explain what happened, describe her bag, and ask what she should do next.

lessons.grammar: past continuous: was / were + -ing
past continuous + when + past simple (I was sleeping when the thief took my bag.)
while + past continuous (While we were waiting, they changed the gate.)

lessons.topic: We had to wait for hours
lessons.grammar: had to / didn't have to (past obligation)
get + adjective / past participle (get lost, get stuck, get delayed)
sentence adverbs: luckily, fortunately, unfortunately, in the end

lessons.topic: Nam's email to Emma: the worst journey of her life
Airport notice: what to do if your bag is lost or damaged

units.title_th: โรงแรมและที่พัก
units.goal_th: เช็คอิน ขอใช้บริการ และแจ้งปัญหาในโรงแรมอย่างสุภาพได้
units.scenario: B is a receptionist at a small hotel in Chiang Mai. Nam must check in, ask about breakfast and the hotel's services, and politely complain that the air conditioning in her room isn't working.

lessons.grammar: present perfect + just (I've just checked in.)
present perfect + already (I've already paid the deposit.)

lessons.topic: Have they cleaned the room yet?
lessons.grammar: present perfect + yet (Have they cleaned it yet? / They haven't cleaned it yet.)
Would it be possible to…? / Is it possible to…? (polite requests)
present simple for timetables and schedules (Breakfast starts at seven.)

lessons.topic: There seems to be a problem
lessons.grammar: polite complaints: I'm sorry to bother you, but… / There seems to be a problem with…

lessons.topic: The hotel's email confirming Nam's booking
Guest reviews: two very different stays at the same hotel

units.title_th: ที่ทำงานและอีเมล
units.goal_th: ทำงานร่วมกับคนในออฟฟิศและเขียนอีเมลงานสั้น ๆ อย่างสุภาพได้
units.scenario: B is Nam's manager during her summer internship at an office in Bangkok. Nam must find out what he wants her to do, agree on deadlines, and write a short polite email to a client.

lessons.grammar: verb + object + to-infinitive (My boss wants me to call the client.)
Would you mind + -ing? (polite requests)

lessons.topic: I'll tell you as soon as I know
lessons.grammar: as soon as + present simple for the future (I'll call you as soon as I get the file.)
look forward to + -ing / I'm writing to + verb (email phrases)
by vs until for deadlines (Send it by Friday. / I'm here until five.)
questions ending with a preposition (Who is it from? / What's it about?)

lessons.topic: A short email chain: Nam asks her manager for a day off
Meet the team: a page from the company's website

units.title_th: งานบ้าน
units.goal_th: แบ่งงานบ้าน ขอให้คนอื่นช่วย และอาสาทำงานบ้านได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, Nam's new roommate. Nam must agree with her who does which chores, ask Emma to help with some jobs, and offer to do others herself.

lessons.topic: Make the bed, do the dishes
lessons.grammar: make vs do (make the bed, do the dishes)

lessons.topic: You don't need to do that
lessons.grammar: need to / don't need to
subject questions (Who cleans the kitchen? / What happened?)

lessons.topic: My parents made me do it
lessons.grammar: make / let + person + verb (My mom made me clean my room.)
separable phrasal verbs: object pronoun position (put it away, not put away it)
Shall I…? for offers (Shall I take out the trash?)

lessons.topic: House rules for the shared apartment, on the fridge door
Who does the housework in Thai and Canadian homes? A short survey

units.title_th: ปัญหาการซื้อของและการคืนสินค้า
units.goal_th: แจ้งปัญหาสินค้า ขอเปลี่ยนหรือขอคืนเงินได้

lessons.grammar: too + adjective (It's too small.)
adjective + enough / not + adjective + enough (It isn't big enough.)
too much / too many + noun
enough + noun (I don't have enough money.)
somewhere / anywhere / nowhere / everywhere

lessons.topic: It was so cheap that I bought two
lessons.grammar: so + adjective + that (It was so cheap that I bought two.)

lessons.topic: Returning a pair of shoes: Nam talks to a shop assistant
Nam's messages to Emma: her online order went wrong

units.title_th: ความทรงจำวัยเด็ก
units.goal_th: เล่าว่าตอนเด็กเคยทำอะไรเป็นประจำ และอะไรเปลี่ยนไปแล้วบ้างได้

lessons.grammar: used to + verb (I used to play in the street.)

lessons.topic: Things I didn't use to like
lessons.grammar: didn't use to + verb

used to vs past simple (habits vs single events)

lessons.topic: I remember playing in the rain
lessons.grammar: remember + -ing for memories (I remember flying kites with my dad.)
still / any more / any longer (I don't live there any more.)

lessons.topic: Nam's grandmother's childhood in a village by the river
Mr. Brown remembers growing up on a farm in Canada

units.title_th: นิสัยและบุคลิก
units.goal_th: บรรยายนิสัยและบุคลิกของคนรอบตัวได้

lessons.grammar: defining relative clauses with who (She's a person who always helps.)
relative clauses with that for people and things
relative clauses with which for things

lessons.grammar: leaving out the relative pronoun (the friend I met in Canada)
adverbs of degree: quite, really, a bit, extremely + adjective
adjective suffixes -ful / -less / -ous (careful, careless, generous)

What does your favorite color say about your personality?

units.title_th: บ้านเกิดและชีวิตในเมือง

lessons.grammar: present perfect + for / since (I've lived here for twenty years.)

lessons.topic: The place where I grew up
lessons.grammar: relative clauses with where (the street where I grew up)

lessons.topic: There used to be a cinema here
lessons.grammar: there used to be / there didn't use to be
modifying comparatives: much / far / a bit + comparative (much bigger)
both / neither / either (Both cities are… / Neither of them…)

lessons.topic: The best place I've ever lived
lessons.grammar: superlative + present perfect (the best place I've ever lived)

lessons.topic: Bangkok then and now: Nam's grandfather tells her how the city has changed
Emma's messages from her small hometown in Canada

units.title_th: นิสัยรักสุขภาพ
units.goal_th: พูดถึงนิสัยการกินการนอน และบอกผลของการเปลี่ยนนิสัยได้

lessons.grammar: ought to / ought not to (advice)

lessons.topic: Walk instead of taking the bus
lessons.grammar: instead of / without + -ing

lessons.topic: Ten small habits that can change your life
Nam's diary: thirty days without sugar

relative clauses with who / that / which (review)

lessons.topic: A short review of a new Thai horror film

units.scenario: B is a park ranger at Khao Yai National Park. Nam must ask which animals live in the park, understand the safety rules, and describe what she saw on the trail.

lessons.grammar: most / some / none of (Most of them… / None of them…)
present continuous for changing situations (Forests are disappearing.)
question tags (It's beautiful, isn't it? / You saw it, didn't you?)
